requested_attestations.request: Confirm the common clock, timezone/offset treatment, reset behavior, and whether a shared operation/event identifier exists.
requested_attestations.acceptance: A de-identified timebase contract plus event-boundary rules; no raw timestamps or tags required.

requested_attestations.request: Confirm each storage-pressure role's engineering unit and absolute/gauge reference, including sensor scale and valid range.
requested_attestations.acceptance: Role-level unit/reference statement and calibration/quality flag definition.

requested_attestations.request: Confirm whether each temperature channel is gas, wall, ambient, compressor discharge, or cooler outlet and provide units and sensor location class.
requested_attestations.acceptance: Role-level semantic map and degC/K conversion rule; no equipment identity required.

requested_attestations.request: Confirm flow direction, engineering units, whether values are mass or volume, and totalizer reset/rollover behavior.
requested_attestations.acceptance: Unit/sign/reset contract plus one aggregate closure statistic supplied by the custodian.

requested_attestations.request: Map compressor, cooling, valve, ESD, and trip state codes to generic operational meanings, including failed-feedback values.
requested_attestations.acceptance: Generic state dictionary and transition validity rules; no raw state strings required.

requested_attestations.request: Confirm whether synchronized vehicle/receptacle pressure, temperature, delivered mass or SOC, dispenser flow, and fill-event identifiers exist.
requested_attestations.acceptance: De-identified channel-family presence/absence matrix and synchronization rule; values remain outside the repository.

requested_attestations.request: Confirm calibration interval, uncertainty/quality flags, missing-value codes, maintenance windows, and sensor replacement handling.
requested_attestations.acceptance: Aggregate uncertainty and missingness policy with a de-identified quality flag dictionary.

requested_attestations.request: Confirm that derived aggregate metrics may be reviewed and that raw data remain owner-controlled and unpublished.
requested_attestations.acceptance: Custodian approval record identifying permitted derived outputs and reviewer access scope.

current_gate_effect.station_side_pressure_and_sequence: eligible after role-level confirmation; current aggregate evidence is descriptive
current_gate_effect.station_side_temperature_flow_state: blocked until the corresponding semantic/unit attestations are supplied
current_gate_effect.station_to_vehicle_full_loop: blocked until synchronized vehicle/dispenser channel families are confirmed and attested
current_gate_effect.safety_limits_and_field_certification: out of scope for this request and remain disabled

custodian_submission_contract: Return only generic role names, units, reference conventions, event rules, and aggregate quality statistics.
Do not return site, company, manufacturer, calendar date, raw tag, raw row, or absolute timestamp.
Hash-lock any owner-controlled private mapping outside the repository before a controlled replay.
Keep validation and parameter fitting splits frozen before numerical outcomes are inspected.
claim_boundary: This is a de-identified request checklist. It does not attest any unconfirmed channel, publish measurements, authorize production retuning, establish safety limits, or certify operation.
